title: Cone formed by revolving right triangle
subject: Mathematics
caption: Cone generated by revolving a right triangle about its leg
altText: A right triangle ABC with right angle at B is shown: side AB is horizontal 8 cm, side BC is vertical 6 cm, and hypotenuse AC is 10 cm. The triangle is revolved around side BC, producing a cone whose height equals BC (6 cm), base radius equals AB (8 cm), and slant height equals AC (10 cm). The cone is drawn with its axis vertical, an ellipse for the base, and lines for the lateral surface. Labels indicate h = 6 cm, r = 8 cm, l = 10 cm, and the surface‑area formula π r (r + l) = 144π cm².
